title: A domain's profile
description: docs/profile.yaml in a domain folder: what this domain adds to the base formats of its rules, glossary and questions — never a change to them (ADR 0016 §8). The platform validates and shows the fields; it never knows what they mean.

fields.description: Extra fields, per format. A name may not be one of the base format's own fields.

external.description: The prefixes of outside lists the domain cites — a test plan, a ticket system — so `why:` and tags with one (TP-12) are references, not typos. The key is the prefix, before the dash.

title.description: What the list is (the test plan).

url.description: Where an item is, with {id} for the item's id; the rulebook links it.

topics.description: The order the rulebook reads in, by topic file name (without .yaml). Topics not named follow, by file name.

description.description: What the field means — shown in the editor and the rulebook.

list.description: A list of values rather than one.

vocabulary.description: A YAML file, relative to docs/, listing the values allowed — for a controlled vocabulary too long for `enum`, such as an industry standard's: `values: [{ value, definition }]`.
